title: A Kingdom Underwater
text: We made it out of Leviathan's Wake! The first thing we found was an entire stone road disappearing between ruined towers. There are banners still caught on the buildings and little merchant stalls everywhere. Glimmer is still wearing the tiny crown. Apparently I am traveling with royalty now.

title: Shizuki's Totally Legitimate Shop
text: Found an abandoned market stall and made a terrible decision: I opened a shop. Sign says 'SHIZUKI'S TOTALLY LEGITIMATE SHOP — EVERYTHING 5 STAR CANDIES — NO REFUNDS.' We had no merchandise and no customers. Business was slow. Glimmer has been promoted to management.

title: The Fountain Wish
text: One of the old fountains still works! Apparently people used to drop silver shells into it when asking the crown for help. I didn't have a silver shell, so I tossed in a shiny pebble and wished for berries. Glimmer looked disappointed. I stand by my methodology.

title: Horse Bed Was Safer
text: We found the royal stables tonight. The castle is full of beautiful bedrooms, but all the portraits stare at you while you sleep. Absolutely not. I made camp in one of the stalls instead. Horse bed: surprisingly comfortable. Glimmer has claimed the hay rack.

title: Traditional Royal Mustache
text: The king's portrait looked extremely serious, so I supplied the traditional ceremonial mustache. Was there previously a traditional ceremonial mustache? No. Tradition has to start somewhere.

title: Berry Agriculture, Attempt Seven
text: Found the royal gardens and decided to plant some berries. Attempt one: nothing. Attempt two: also nothing. Attempt three through six: we don't discuss those. ATTEMPT SEVEN HAS SPROUTED. I am officially a farmer. Glimmer is not allowed to eat the evidence.

title: The Crownmarket Menu
text: An old food stall still has its menu carved into the counter. Honey cakes, moonfruit pastries, spiced kelp buns... this kingdom knew how to LIVE. Unfortunately, the food has been gone for centuries. I stared at the menu long enough that Glimmer started chiming sympathetically.

title: The Drowned Archive
text: The library here isn't full of dramatic royal secrets. Mostly it's recipes, children's stories, shopping records, love letters, terrible poetry, and complaints about neighbors. I love it. Somehow reading about ordinary people makes the empty streets feel less empty.

title: Royal Waterworks Incident
text: I touched ONE glowing switch in the palace cistern. Every fountain in the room turned on at once. Glimmer got launched across the chamber. I got launched immediately afterward. We are both fine. The fountain system is extremely enthusiastic.

title: Up-Ish
text: The palace map is impossible. Too many stairways. Too many towers. Too many halls. I have begun labeling every staircase 'UP-ISH.' Glimmer says this is not useful cartography. Glimmer has never made a map and therefore has no professional authority.

title: Sir Barrelton
text: WE FOUND THE JOUSTING ARENA. I put a barrel on an old cart, drew a face on it, and named him Sir Barrelton. He challenged me first. The remains of Sir Barrelton are now on the opposite side of the arena. A worthy opponent.

title: The Slowest Royal Guard
text: Some of the enchanted statues still patrol the palace! Very slowly. One noticed us, raised its arm dramatically, and spent almost three full minutes pointing toward a doorway. We waited because it seemed important. It was pointing toward a broom closet.

title: Portrait of Lord Fish
text: Coral has grown through the old portrait hall, and tiny fish keep swimming through the empty frames. One little silver fish stayed inside a portrait long enough that I named him Lord Fish of Something Important. Glimmer bowed. I think we've been in this kingdom too long.

title: The Singing Chalices
text: Hundreds of silver cups hang inside an old chapel. When the current passes through, they ring like tiny bells. I tried tapping one to join the song. Every chalice rang at once. I have once again improved local music.

title: Cooking Is Not Alchemy
text: Found the royal kitchens. Important discovery: cooking is basically alchemy. UPDATE: cooking is NOT basically alchemy. I don't know how that pot ended up upside down on the ceiling. Glimmer refuses to discuss the incident.

title: And They're Racing!
text: The old royal canal still has a starting bell. I rang it. Apparently the tiny creatures living here know EXACTLY what it means because twelve of them immediately started racing down the canal. Glimmer joined. Glimmer did not win. We are not discussing the results.

title: House Berry
text: The heraldry hall has hundreds of old family crests. Lions, swords, moons, sea dragons... very dignified. I designed my own: a berry wearing a crown. House Berry. Motto: 'Probably Fine.' Glimmer approves.

title: ACCESS DENIED
text: Found an old royal vault with a magical lock that keeps shouting 'ACCESS DENIED.' Very intimidating. Minor problem: the actual door fell off sometime in the last few centuries. I walked around it. The lock is still yelling. I almost feel bad.

title: Royal Bath Privileges
text: THE BATHHOUSE STILL WORKS. I repeat: THE ROYAL BATHHOUSE STILL WORKS. Heated water. Glowing tiles. Giant pool. Nobody around to tell me I'm not allowed in. Royal bath privileges acquired. Glimmer is floating in a soap bubble.

title: I Won Something!
text: Found an old covered walkway full of little magical games. I activated one and absolutely did not understand the rules. Lights flashed. Bells rang. Something yelled 'WINNER!' and handed me a prize anyway. Finally, a game that respects talent.

title: Mr. Fluff, Bitey, and Sir Shellington
text: The royal menagerie is empty now, but the old plaques are still here. ROYAL SILVER LION is clearly Mr. Fluff. GREAT CRESTED WYVERN is Bitey. IMPERIAL WAR TORTOISE is Sir Shellington. I have corrected the records. You're welcome, historians.

title: The Palace Gates
text: We finally reached the enormous pearl-covered gates to the inner palace. They opened when we approached, slowly enough to be VERY dramatic about it. Beyond them is the whole royal district glowing beneath the water. Glimmer's crown somehow looks appropriate now. I don't like encouraging this.

title: Five-Star Performance
text: Found the royal theater and repaired just enough of the stage to perform. Audience attendance: Glimmer. Reviews: ★★★★★ 'Incredible performance.' —Shizuki. ★★★★★ 'Changed my life.' —Definitely Not Shizuki. ★★★★★ 'Give her an award.' —Anonymous Elf. Critics agree.

title: The Hedge Maze Incident
text: Royal hedge maze. Easy. I left myself signs. 'EXIT →' Then '← ACTUAL EXIT.' Then 'IGNORE FIRST TWO SIGNS.' Then 'I HAVE MADE A TERRIBLE MISTAKE.' Glimmer eventually found me sitting beside my own first sign. We are never speaking of this again.

title: The Forgotten Prince
text: Found a quiet wing of the palace that belonged to one of the princes. No giant treasure. No dramatic secret. Just unfinished books, old drawings, a broken instrument, little collections, and marks measuring someone's height as they grew. It's strange how a room can remember a person better than history does.

title: The Queen's Tear Fountain
text: There's a fountain shaped like the old queen looking toward the sea. Instead of falling, the water rises in glowing droplets and floats above the courtyard like stars. Glimmer sat among them until I could barely tell which light was the sprite. I didn't hurry.

title: The Royal Dinner Guests
text: I arranged a banquet today. Guests included Sir Helmet, Lady Vase, Lord Broom, a broken statue head, and one extremely important fake mustache. The king's chair is marked 'RESERVED.' Glimmer sat there anyway. Treason.

title: Festival Street
text: We found an entire street covered in old festival decorations. Most of the magic is asleep, but one lantern flickered on when we passed. Then another. For a moment I could almost imagine the stalls full, music playing, people everywhere. I really wish I'd seen this place when it was alive.

title: The Throne at the End
text: Reached the throne room today. After all those enormous roads, gates, banners, statues, and halls... the throne itself is just a chair. A very fancy chair, but still. I found an inscription calling it 'eternal authority.' I added underneath: 'very temporary furniture.' Glimmer is currently sitting on it wearing the crown. Point proven.

title: The King's Festival
text:
Something incredible happened tonight.

We found the old festival courtyard behind the palace. The moment we stepped inside, every lantern lit at once. Banners unfurled. Illusory musicians appeared on the stage. The merchant stalls glowed. The game booths woke up. For a little while, the kingdom wasn't empty anymore.

Obviously I tried everything.

ARCHERY: Shizuki — 3. Royal Champion — 10. Rigged.

RING TOSS: Shizuki — 0. Also rigged.

PASTRY EATING CONTEST: Shizuki — 47.

Champion.

Glimmer danced with the festival lights until the magic finally started fading. I think this might be my favorite place we've found.

When the last lantern went dark, something beyond the palace lit up instead—a strange current full of stars, bending in directions currents absolutely should not bend.

The old maps call the path the Astral Nexus.

Glimmer is already going.

I really need to stop letting Glimmer choose our destinations~
